post.summary:
CreateNewScript | Create a new script with new address = hash(creator +
content), a new authz updatescript permission will also be created for the
creator
ExecScript executes a script by calling a function with arguments.

Sudo defines a governance operation for executing arbitrary messages
with authority override. The authority defaults to the x/gov module
account. Messages are executed without signer validation.

UpdateParams defines a governance operation for updating the x/script
module parameters. The authority defaults to the x/gov module account.

Update Script updates the script of the given address and increments the
the version.

creator_address.description: creator is the account address creating the script.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgCreateNewScri.description: MsgCreateNewScript is the Msg/CreateNewScript request type.

script_address.description: script_address is the address of the newly created script.

version.description: version is the initial script version.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgCreateNewScri.description: MsgCreateNewScriptResponse is the Msg/CreateNewScript response type.

executor_address.description: executor is the account address used to execute the script.

script_address.description: address is the script bech32 address to execute.

script_name.title:
script_name is the optional nameservice name of the script to execute
(e.g., "example.dys")

extra_code.description:
Only if the executor is the owner of the script  will the optional
extra_code be temporary appended to the script for this message before
calling the function.

args.title:
The positional arguments to pass to the function (*args) encoded as a
json list

kwargs.title:
The keyword argument to pass to the function (**kwargs) encoded as a
json dict

attached_messages.description:
The list of messages to run before the script and the result will be
available in `dys.get_attached_messages()`. If any of the attached messages
fails, the script execution will be aborted. The script can assume that the
attached messages have been executed successfully by virtue of the fact
that the script execution will never occur if any of the attached messages
had failed. The attached messages are executed in the order they are
provided.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgExec.description: MsgExec executes a script by calling a function with arguments.

result.description: result is the final result of the proposal execution.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgExecResponse.description: MsgExecResponse is the Msg/Exec request type.

authority.description:
authority is the address that controls the module (defaults to x/gov unless
overwritten).

messages.description:
messages is the list of messages to execute without signer validation.
All messages will be executed in order, and if any fails, the entire
transaction is reverted.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgSudo.description:
MsgSudo is the Msg/Sudo request type for governance-controlled message
execution.

results.description: results contains the response messages from each executed message.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgSudoResponse.description: MsgSudoResponse is the Msg/Sudo response type.

authority.description:
authority is the address that controls the module (defaults to x/gov unless
overwritten).

params.description:
params defines the x/script parameters to update.

NOTE: All parameters must be supplied.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgUpdateParams.description: MsgUpdateParams is the Msg/UpdateParams request type.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgUpdateParamsR.description:
MsgUpdateParamsResponse defines the response structure for executing a
MsgUpdateParams message.

address.description: address is the account address of the script.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgUpdateScript.description: MsgUpdateScript is the Msg/UpdateScript request type.

version.description: version is the updated script version.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgUpdateScriptR.description: MsgUpdateScriptResponse is the Msg/UpdateScript response type.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.Params.description:
Params defines the parameters for the script module.
Historical query-related fields have been removed; this message is currently
empty.

value.description: Must be a valid serialized protocol buffer of the above specified type.
